relationships.note: He states the jubilee happens because foreclosure is impossible once the dollar crashes.
Fear of touching cash during the plague is given as what carries the digital system through.
He states the quake triggers a Yellowstone reaction; both sit in the same canonical claim for now.
He states the US abandoning Israel is what opens the door to the Chinese attack.
Looting and empty stores are stated as consequences of the economy crashing.
Inference, not his: nationwide crop failure would plausibly precede retail scarcity. He never links them.
Fill your pockets, for a great storm is coming: the window is explicitly the run-up to the crash.
Told as one sequence (crash, plague, new digital dollar) without an explicit causal claim, so narrative_sequence rather than causes.
